rules: The dimensional search fields are a contract target, not product data by themselves.
Do not infer compatibility, material or dimensions from the reference image.
Do not reuse images, SKUs or dimensions from VedaShow.
Only approved records may enter the 3D catalog and AVX-tools manifest.
reviewGates: Match every selected product to one official code and one primary image.
Confirm internal diameter, external diameter and height or thickness in millimetres.
Keep unmatched photos outside the 3D catalog until identity is proven.
